name: Printing and Free Distribution of Sanskrit Textbooks
benefit: **Each student is provided annual financial assistance under the scheme as follows:** - Classes 1st to 5th: ₹250/- per student - Classes 6th to 8th: ₹400/- per student - Classes 9th to 10th: ₹600/- per student - Classes 11th to 12th: ₹700/- per student
_eligibility_text: 1. The students studying in Classes 1 to 12 at Sanskrit schools across Uttarakhand are eligible.
